meta.provenance_note: Read directly from the PDF via PyMuPDF on 2026-09-17 — extraction is clean (this book is in English). Unit titles, page numbers, vocabulary, grammar structures (with the book's own example sentences), and skill descriptors were taken from the book's own two-page 'Scope and sequence' table (pp. 4-5), the same source and treatment as g5EnglishSem1.ts. Individual page-by-page lesson numbering inside each unit was not reconstructed; each unit here is split into exactly two lessons — Vocabulary & Grammar, and Listening & Speaking — reflecting the two content halves the scope-and-sequence table itself separates.
known_gaps: 2026-09-19 verification: this file's unit-level content (unit titles/order, vocabulary lists, grammar rules with the book's own example sentences, and 'Listening' skill descriptors) was checked page by page against the book's own Scope and sequence table (pp. 4-5) and against the unit body pages themselves (Welcome pp. 6-9; Unit 1 'New school' pp. 8-19 in full; spot checks of Units 2-4's vocabulary/grammar pages) — every item matches the book verbatim, and nothing is invented or missing at this level.

That same page-by-page check confirms this file's lesson-level granularity is still coarser than the book's own page layout. Inside each unit the book prints its own numbered running heads: the Welcome unit has 'Lesson 1'-'Lesson 3' ('Countries and nationalities', 'Hobbies', 'Numbers'), and every other unit has 8 lessons, numbered 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10 (headers Vocabulary / Story / Grammar / Vocabulary and Grammar / Culture / English in Action (Pronunciation) / Reading / Writing) — consistently skipping 4 and 6, most likely Activity-Book-only sessions not printed in this student book. This confirms, with concrete numbers, the odd/even pattern g5EnglishSem1.ts's known_gaps flagged as 'not reliably reconstructable' — deliberately left unreconstructed here too: splitting each unit into its true ~8 lessons would be a rebuild (new lesson ids, and per-lesson vocabulary/grammar/skill content read off ~40 more pages per semester), and it would break this file's consistency with every sibling grade's English catalog in this series, which all use the same two-lesson simplification. No code in this repo hardcodes today's u*_l1/u*_l2 ids (checked via repo-wide grep), so nothing here is blocked on that count — the reconstruction itself is simply out of scope for this verification pass and is left for a dedicated follow-up.

The scope-and-sequence table's 'Listening' column is the only skill descriptor captured in each unit's second ('Listening & Speaking') lesson; the table's Speaking / Reading / Writing / Phonics / Project / Viewing-and-presenting / Functions columns (book p. 5) are not represented anywhere in this file. 'Listening & Speaking' is this catalog's own umbrella label for that lesson — the book itself never prints a combined 'Listening & Speaking' heading.

Following the g5EnglishSem1.ts precedent for English-subject books, `main_idea_ar` and `objectives` hold literal English text (this book's own language), not Arabic; `title_ar` carries a plain Arabic gloss of the English title for search/display.

'Hello from Hamed!' style Welcome unit for this semester is 'New neighbours', included as Unit 1 because it carries its own vocabulary and grammar row in the scope-and-sequence table like every other unit.

Excluded as supplementary, non-core material (no dedicated row in the scope-and-sequence table): the 'Bo's Learning Club: Language booster 1' spread, the 'Science: Can plants grow in water?' page, the 'Festivals' pages (World Environment Day, World Friendship Day, Flag Day), 'Solve it', and the 'Grammar reference' appendix.
